adjudication.rationale: In new `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the message handler uses `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`, which is a substring/prefix check rather than an exact origin comparison. If `discourseUrl` is `http://forum.example.com/`, an origin like `http://forum.example.co` will yield `indexOf(...) === 0` and incorrectly pass the check, allowing non-Discourse origins to trigger the resize behavior.
